item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera is 13 years old. Lately she feels strong emotions, such as sudden excitement or anger, and her mother in Pune notices changes in her behaviour. What is the best understanding of Meera's situation?

options.A: Adolescence involves only physical changes like height and voice; Meera's feelings are unrelated.
options.B: Meera's stronger emotions are caused by her behaviour, so emotions always come after actions.
options.C: Adolescence includes emotional and behavioural changes as well as physical changes, and understanding her emotions can help Meera make thoughtful choices.
options.D: Only confusing feelings count as emotional changes in adolescence; excitement does not.
